title: A Cover for the Deadline
author: Isandro Voss
blurb: Astrid Voss, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
